values: This is an RGBA format image with transparency. A full-body chibi anime girl character. She has fluffy shoulder-length warm terracotta-orange hair with a small ahoge, a cream-white eight-pointed starburst hair clip on the left side, large round amber eyes and rosy cheeks. She wears an oversized cream knit cardigan with terracotta-orange trim over a white blouse, a short chocolate-brown pleated skirt, white socks and brown loafers. She stands facing the viewer, smiling gently with her hands clasped in front of her. Cute hand-drawn chibi anime illustration in the style of a Japanese doujin music video: thin warm dark-brown line art, flat cel shading with soft pastel colors, simple expressive face with big round eyes, big head and small body about 2.5 heads tall, clean outlines, no background objects, no text. The image has an alpha channel and a transparent background.
